parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain what is meant by equity and how the ban on motorcycle taxis and tricycles affects
equity for commuters in Lagos.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain, with the help of a diagram, what is meant by a negative externality and identify two
examples of negative externalities from the article.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
From the evidence, consider whether the Singapore quota system or the ERP was more
effective in solving the problem of traffic congestion.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Assess whether government’s involvement in the provision of transport systems is because
transport is a public good.
